notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one additional creature card in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You control a Mountain.
description:
Activate Whisper by tapping and sacrificing it and another nontoken creature you control, targeting any applicable creature card in your graveyard except Anger.
Ashnod triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Whisper.
Resolve both Whisper abilities, returning Whisper and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
